speaker: gauge
text: Nine skinny towers glued together? Seems flimsy.

speaker: fitz
text:
Wait. It's one tower, made of nine square tubes tied together.
Wind tries to bend tall buildings.

speaker: fitz
text:
Engineer Fazlur Khan put the strength in each tube's outer walls.
Each tube is stiff alone. Tied together, they brace each other and act as one.

speaker: fitz
text:
Right. One straw bends. A bundle is much harder to bend.
And the steps? Some tubes just stop partway up.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
